settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.language_helper: Language of GLPI pages and notifications. Each user can change it in their preferences
settings.admin_account_info_first: The local glpi account has the Super-Admin profile. Choose its password now: the default glpi password is replaced. The demo accounts tech, normal and post-only are disabled.
settings.admin_account_info_set: The local glpi account has the Super-Admin profile and always works, even if the user domain is unavailable.
settings.no_user_domain_description: Only GLPI local accounts can log in. Create or join a user domain (OpenLDAP or Active Directory) to let domain users log in to GLPI.
settings.ldap_authentication_tooltip: Users of the selected user domain log in to GLPI with their domain credentials. GLPI local accounts keep working.
settings.ldap_info_description: A GLPI account is created at the first login with the Self-Service profile. Members of the administrators group get the Super-Admin profile instead.
settings.admin_group_helper: Members of this group get the GLPI Super-Admin profile
settings.ldap_sync_tooltip: Every day, GLPI updates names and emails of domain users and disables the accounts removed from the domain. User data is also updated at each login.
settings.smarthost_disabled_description: GLPI sends emails through the cluster smarthost, which is not configured. Configure it to enable ticket notifications.
settings.smarthost_enabled_description: GLPI sends emails through the cluster smarthost {host}.
settings.mail_from_helper: Address used as sender of GLPI notifications
settings.mail_from_format: Must be a valid email address
settings.language_enum: Choose a language from the list
settings.no_route_title: This instance has no web address
settings.no_route_description: This instance is a clone and keeps the host name of its source. Set a new host name and save to make GLPI reachable.
settings.user_domain_not_found: This user domain does not exist
settings.admin_password_too_weak: Use at least 8 characters with lowercase and uppercase letters, a number and a symbol
settings.admin_password_required: Choose a password for the glpi account
